steps.en: Load the staging skill and provide screenplay, art and scene images
steps.zh: 加载站位技能并提供剧本、美术与场景图

steps.en: Seed cast and locations, then ask the agent to fill opening positions
steps.zh: 预填人物地点，再由 agent 填开场位置

steps.en: Check structure and render the editable top-view report
steps.zh: 检查结构并渲染可编辑俯视报告

steps.en: Review positions and export corrected staging JSON
steps.zh: 审核位置并导出修改后的站位数据

steps.en: Generate accepted opening blocking sentences for the storyboard handoff
steps.zh: 生成供分镜交接使用的开场走位句

value.en: Every scene starts from one reviewable spatial plan
value.zh: 每场戏从一份可审核的空间计划开始
